scope: Literal native HID total-envelope and pending-source admission through pinned C and Rust. Same event-level drained HID IN schedule as HID ownership suite; no physical or withheld-IN acceptance.

cases.preconditions: Fresh storage; configured USB. Poll CCID, HID and WebUSB in device_loop order for each event. Drain HID IN to idle within that event, completing each report and resuming Rust TX; C TX waits synchronously for completion. Fixed nonzero CID; no INIT allocation or response normalization.

difference.reason: With CTAP freshly installed and no PIN, C has no retry attribute and encodes LFS_ERR_NOATTR(-61) as a negative counter; Rust returns8. Do not normalize or reproduce the negative counter.
